rows.quote: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis data were derived from GWAS data from the UK Biobank (17), and included 1, 369 patients of European ancestry and 435, 866 control subjects of European ancestry.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: GWAS data from the UK Biobank (17)
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the UK Biobank GWAS of reference 17 (Duckworth et al. 2021) with its case and control counts; the dictionary has no row for that study.
